newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL SHARES END UP IN VOLATILE TRADE ON FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL SHARES END UP IN VOLATILE TRADE ON FUTURES.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed higher on Wednesday in moderate turnover amid volatility due to futures settlements and fluctuations on Wall Street after the release of U.S. retail sales and producer price data, brokers said.
"We had super volatility today mostly because of expiration of the futures index," said a dealer with local Crefisul brokerage.
The Sao Paulo bolsa's Bovespa index of 47 most-traded shares rose 0.35 percent to end at 11,851 points Wednesday on volume of 842.8 million reais ($776.8 million).
